title: Catalog job connects to an absent database
root_cause: The workflow changed PGDATABASE from bracken_catalog to bracken_archive while the PostgreSQL service still initializes bracken_catalog. The client reaches PostgreSQL but the requested database does not exist, so the connection fails before the test can query it.

relevant_evidence.why: The test fails during connection because PostgreSQL cannot find the requested database.
The service initializes a different database name.
